action_resolutions.summary: Italy launched a two-pronged full-scale offensive into Ethiopia from Eritrea in the north and Italian Somaliland in the south, mobilizing elite Blackshirt divisions and committing air assets to break Ethiopian defenses.

operation.reason: Execution of the East African campaign to conquer and annex Ethiopia.

reports.title: The Advance into Tigray
reports.report: Italian forces pushing south from Eritrea encountered stubborn Ethiopian defense in the rugged terrain of Tigray. Backed by Regia Aeronautica bombing runs, the Italian infantry and Blackshirt divisions slowly overcame local resistance, securing initial footholds across the border despite logistical bottlenecks and harassing guerrilla counter-attacks.

events.title: Abdication Crisis of Edward VIII
events.description: In the United Kingdom, King Edward VIII accedes to the throne following the death of George V in January, setting off a constitutional crisis regarding his proposed marriage to Wallis Simpson.

events.title: League of Nations Imposes Sanctions on Italy
events.description: In response to the ongoing Italian invasion of Ethiopia, the League of Nations increases diplomatic and economic pressure, though major powers fail to agree on an oil embargo.
